title: AlphaFlowTSE: One-Step Generative Target Speaker Extraction via Conditional AlphaFlow
abstract: arXiv:2603.10701v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Target speaker extraction (TSE) aims to recover the speech of a specified speaker from a multi-talker mixture using a short enrollment utterance from that speaker. Real conversational applications require both high extraction quality and low-latency inference across complex mixture conditions. Existing generative TSE approaches improve speech fidelity, but diffusion and flow-based models usually rely on multi-step sampling. One-step variants reduce iterative inference cost, yet often require estimating a trajectory coordinate related to the mixing ratio, introducing an additional dependency. We propose AlphaFlowTSE, which formulates TSE as finite-interval transport from the observed mixture to clean target speech. translated_title: AlphaFlowTSE：基于条件AlphaFlow的单步生成式目标说话人提取
translated_abstract: 目标说话人提取（TSE）旨在利用目标说话人的一段简短注册语音，从多人混合语音中恢复指定说话人的语音。真实的对话应用要求在复杂混合条件下同时具备高提取质量和低延迟推理。现有的生成式TSE方法提升了语音保真度，但基于扩散模型和流模型的方法通常依赖多步采样。单步变体虽然降低了迭代推理成本，但往往需要估计与混合比例相关的轨迹坐标，从而引入了额外的依赖。我们提出AlphaFlowTSE，将TSE表述为从观测混合语音到干净目标语音的有限区间传输。AlphaFlowTSE沿混合语音到目标语音的轨迹学习条件平均速度，并使用无需雅可比向量积（JVP-free）的AlphaFlow目标函数，将局部轨迹匹配与区间一致的教师-学生监督相结合。
tldr: 提出AlphaFlowTSE，将目标说话人提取建模为混合语音到目标语音的有限区间传输，通过无需JVP的条件AlphaFlow目标结合局部轨迹匹配与教师-学生监督，实现无需多步采样的单步高质量低延迟语音提取。
en_tdlr: AlphaFlowTSE formulates target speaker extraction as finite-interval transport from the mixture to clean speech, learning a conditional mean velocity with a JVP-free AlphaFlow objective that combines local trajectory matching and interval-consistent teacher-student supervision, enabling one-step, high-quality, low-latency extraction without multi-step sampling.
